objectives:
教育學生完整深入的保育知識與方法
Educate students with comprehensive and in-depth knowledge and methods of conservation.
content:
1	Introduction of Conservation Biology
2	The Value of Biodiversity
3	Conservation in Theory
4	Conservation in Practice
5	Conservation Outside Protected Area
6	Population structure and Molecular Systematics in Cetacean
7	Conservation of the Felidae
8   Conservation in Canidae
9	Socioecology, Population Fragmentation, and Genetic loos in Primates
10	Avise Conservation Genetics
11	Conservation Genetics of Marian Turtles
12	Conserving Evolutionary Process in Bovidae
13	Conservation Genetics in Fishes
14	Conservation Genetics of Endemic Plant Species
15	Wildlife harvesting
16	Ecosystem management and conservation
17	Flexible adjustment
18	Flexible adjustment
books:
A Primer of Conservation Biology, 2012, Fifth edition, Richard B. Primack, SINAUER.
Conservation Genetics,2002 John E. Avise & James L. Hamrick, Kluwer Acad. Pub.
